Now I find myself comforting this blonde fairy.

Until the imperial physician diagnosed her with an incurable disease, and her time was limited. The Duke questioned her coldly, “Are you done causing a scene?” and left with a wave of his sleeve.

91213.synopsis:
Ever since rebirth novels became popular, every story has an unlucky man in it.
In their previous life, they were abandoned and hurt by their original wives and later achieved success with their own abilities. 
Only when their first wives were on their deathbeds did they realize these men’s worth. After being reborn, they would turn over a new leaf and work together to reach the pinnacle of life. 
Tang Momo couldn’t grasp the sense of satisfaction from these stories at all; she only felt frustrated and uncomfortable. 
Suddenly, she found herself inside a rebirth novel as a minor character.
At that moment, the female protagonist had just been reborn, and the plot hadn’t even started yet. 
It was the day before the male and female protagonist were supposed to meet for the first time. 
Out of gratitude for the soldier’s life-saving act, Tang Momo knocked on the door next to hers and decided to give him a kind reminder. 
“Um, maybe you should consider seeing a few more prospects before you make a decision?” Tang Momo said tactfully. 
“Okay, I understand,” the soldier smiled ambiguously.
Tang Momo was confused. What did he understand?
It wasn’t until the next day, when the soldier brought a matchmaker to her house to propose, that Tang Momo quickly shook her head in refusal. No, her goal was to be rich; how could she delay the male protagonist?
*** 
Ever since that rainy night when Gu Chengze rescued Tang Momo, who had fallen into a trap on the mountain.
He always heard some strange noises.
[In this life, I won’t foolishly elope with that educated youth again. I’ll be a good wife to Aze and wait to become an official’s wife.]  
[Should I remind Gu Chengze or not?]  
[Why hasn’t Aze sent a matchmaker yet?]  
[Out of gratitude for his life-saving grace, I should give him a heads-up.]  
Gu Chengze couldn’t help but frown. What did she want to remind him of? 
Shouldn’t life-saving grace be repaid with marriage? 
*** 
Xu Xiaoyun was reborn. In this life, she wouldn’t do anything foolish again. All she needed to do now was to obediently wait for Gu Chengze to come with a matchmaker to propose. 
But she waited and waited, only to hear the news that Gu Chengze had gone to the Tang family to propose but was rejected by that short-lived girl from the Tang family. 
Later, Xu Xiaoyun could only watch as Tang Momo, who was supposed to die young, got into college, started a factory, married Gu Chengze, and became a winner in life that everyone envied.

[System: A gift for the possessed who is flustered by the sudden possession!
I will give you one of the abilities of the female protagonist in a web novel you read in the past!]

92493.synopsis:

When he awoke, he was back in his original world… but in the same body as five years ago.
Soon after his return, he finds himself under attack—by hordes of obsessive yanderes! Bewildered, Kyosuke begins to wonder if he’s returned to a world of reversed gender roles or some kind of apocalyptic nightmare.

110669.synopsis:

Zheng Shanci feels bitterness in his mouth. This person is the definition of a drama queen—a pampered noble heir of the Marquis household, arrogant and spoiled. Meanwhile, he himself is a third-rank scholar from a humble background, just about to take his post in a small county.

Soon, Yu Lanyi realizes this cheap husband of his might actually have potential.
Everyone thought Yu Lanyi’s life was over—married off to the backwater countryside. They all mocked him. But in the end, every single one of them got a slap in the face.

116813.synopsis:
